newsitem.title: USA: USDA details products affected by Hudson recall.
newsitem.headline: USDA details products affected by Hudson recall.

text.p: USDA said the following Hudson Foods products were affected by the recall of hamburger patties announced earlier on Friday.
-- All 3-pound packages of "Hudson Beef Burgers, Individually Quick Frozen," containing 12 quarter-pound frozen patties, with the code 1567A embossed on the botton of the bag.
-- All 3-pound packages of "Hudson 100 Percent Pure Beef Patties, Individually Quick Frozen," containing 12 quarter-pound frozen patties, with the code 156B7 embossed on the bottom of the bag.

-- All 15-pound boxes of "Hudson 60 quarter-pound Beef Patties, Uncooked Individually Quick Frozen," containing 60 quarter-pound frozen patties, with the code 155B7 embossed on the bar code of the side panel of the box.
USDA said "Est. 13569" appears inside the USDA inspection seal on the label of the three products.
Additional product codes could also be involved in the recall, USDA said. These codes will be announced as soon as they are identified.
